name: Yozza SMP » Java & Bedrock Survival
description:
🌟 Welcome to Yozza! 🌟

Yozza is a fun, friendly Minecraft server made for both Bedrock and Java players. Play on your phone, console, or PC. Everyone plays together!

📱 Made for Bedrock, Open to Java 💻

We built Yozza with Bedrock players in mind, so menus and controls work smoothly on mobile and console. Java players are always welcome too. Crossplay is fully supported!

⚔️ What You Can Do on Yozza:

📜 Quests: Take on story and daily quests for rewards

💼 Jobs: Pick a job, level up, and earn money

🏆 Battlepass: Unlock new rewards as you play

🏰 Dungeons: Team up with friends and explore dangerous places

👹 Bosses: Fight strong bosses and win loot

✨ And much, much more!

🎁 Even More Features:

🎁 Crates: Open crates and win items, money and surprises

🛒 Shops: Buy and sell with other players in player shops

💰 Economy: Earn money, trade with friends and get rich your way

🏡 Land Claim: Claim your land and keep your builds safe

🏘️ Towny: Start a town, invite friends and grow together

🎖️ Ranks: Earn ranks as you play and unlock new perks

🎮 How to Join Yozza:

☕ Java Edition: Add play.yozzasmp.com and join, version 1.21.4

📱 Bedrock Edition: Add play.yozzasmp.com with port 25674

✅ No mods needed: Just add the server, join and start playing

🌍 Location: United States, 50 player slots, open to everyone

⭐ Why Players Like Yozza:

⏰ Daily Rewards: Log in every day and claim your rewards

🎉 Fun Events: Join events and challenges with other players

🛡️ Safe Survival: Your land and builds stay protected

🚀 No Lag Play: Smooth menus made for phone and console

🆕 New Content: New quests, items and features to discover

🤝 Play Together: One world for Java and Bedrock friends

🎮 Any Device: Phone, tablet, console, PC or Mac all work

💬 Helpful Staff: Ask in game anytime and get help fast

🏗️ Survival, Your Way:

🏠 Build a base, a farm, a shop, or a whole town

⚔️ Fight bosses and explore dungeons when you want action
